northStar: A sport-walkman tape machine: text becomes a labelled cassette, playback is mechanical keys, the voice's position is yellow word-light behind smoke glass.

motion.reels: rAF loop, velocity lerp toward 0.9 rev/s, gated by prefers-reduced-motion

extensions.focus: 2px solid #161409 on yellow surfaces; 2px solid #FFC907 on dark surfaces; outline-offset 2-3px

breakpoints.desktop-presentation: >=500px centers the device on #232019 with 26px radius
breakpoints.short-viewport: <=640px height compresses cassette and keys, reading 17px

extensions.assets: Michroma and Caveat latin woff2 subsets embedded as base64 data URIs in index.html; icons are inline SVG drawn in tape-deck grammar
